title: URL state
summary: Move a search and a category filter out of useState and into the address with useSearchParams, so that a shopper can bookmark a search, share it, and press Back through it. You will show the shareable address on the page with a copy button and then walk the whole shop from the address bar as an integration check.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
